summary: Strengthen tax risk, transfer pricing, IAS 12, and VAT/GST workflows. Explore the five-day course and practical curriculum.
lede: Tax planning and compliance training helps tax professionals, finance leaders, and advisers assess tax positions and strengthen reporting controls. Case-based exercises cover building tax risk registers, reviewing transfer pricing documentation, reconciling VAT/GST data, and assessing IAS 12 tax provisions. Participants also map filing controls and explore e-invoicing and AI-assisted review, while Pillar Two receives practical orientation rather than implementation-level treatment.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is for professionals who handle corporate tax planning, tax accounting, reporting, or tax-risk controls as part of their regular responsibilities.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of corporate tax, tax accounting, or tax compliance processes is recommended. No programming is required. Bring familiarity with spreadsheet formulas and, where possible, a non-confidential example of a tax process or reporting challenge; do not bring confidential taxpayer data.
